# Harmo

> A CSS-first UI library for dashboards and applications: native HTML elements styled by `.h<name>` classes, with variants and states as attributes and theming through `--harmo-*` custom properties. Use it as HTML and CSS, or through the React components in `@harmo-ui/react`, which render the same markup; each component page's React section lists their props. Both `@harmo-ui/css` and `@harmo-ui/react` are on npm.

Rules for writing Harmo markup:

- Load `tokens.css` once, then each component's file, or `index.css` for everything. Each component page's Contract table lists the files it needs.
- One class per component, such as `.hbutton`; its parts are `.h<name>-<part>`, such as `.hbutton-label`. Variants and states are attributes, never extra classes: `data-variant="secondary"`, `data-size="small"`, `disabled`, `aria-invalid="true"`.
- Use the native elements shown in each page's Markup (`<button type="button">`, `<a href>`, `<input>`), with the ARIA attributes shown there.
- Ids must be unique on a page, and so must each popup trigger's `anchor-name` (Tooltip reuses one name, scoped to each trigger). Every `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-controls`, `for`, `popovertarget`, and `commandfor` must point to an id that exists. A popup trigger's `anchor-name` matches its popup's `position-anchor`.
- The CSS ships no script. Where a Contract's Script row says "Required", HTML without React must do what it lists itself: Calendar, Combobox, Command Menu, Composer, Conversation, Copy Button, Date Filter, Date Picker, Drop Zone, Dropdown Menu, Filter Chip, Filters, Footer, Header, Language Picker, Launcher, Listbox, Mentions, Meter, Navigation Menu, Password Input, Popup, Select, Tabs with panels, Tag List, Time Picker, Toast, and Tooltip (Escape must hide it). Others need one for part of what they do, and their Script row says which, such as File Input showing the file's name, Menu Button's `aria-expanded`, Phone Input's formatting, Search's clear button, Sidebar's toggle, and Table of Contents' current section. The example scripts in `examples/html/src/scripts` show how; the React components do it for you.
- In a form, a Select's trigger is a button and sends nothing: give it `data-name`, give each option a `data-value`, and put a `.hselect-fallback` just before the trigger, holding a native `<select>` with the `name`, an `<option>` for each option with `selected` on the chosen ones (and, for a single select with a placeholder or nothing chosen, a first `<option value="" disabled>`), the trigger's `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, and `aria-invalid`, and an Expand Chevron. It shows until the script hides it with `hidden`, so the form works without JavaScript, and it's what the form sends: keep its selected options in step with the list, and disable it with the trigger. No hidden inputs.
- Theme by overriding `--harmo-*` tokens on `:root` or a containing element, not by restyling classes. On a containing element, also redeclare tokens built from the ones you change, such as `--harmo-focus-outline`.
- For a brand color, run `npx harmo-ui theme "<hex>"`: it writes `harmo-theme.css`, every role in light and dark mode at WCAG AA, adapted from the nearest accent, and adds it to `harmo.css` when there is one. Prefer it to setting primary colors by hand. By hand, set the whole family, as a theme does: `--harmo-color-primary`, `-primary-hover`, `-primary-active`, `-primary-tint`, `-primary-fill`, `-primary-fill-hover`, `-primary-fill-active`, `--harmo-color-on-primary`, `--harmo-switch-thumb-color-background`, `--harmo-color-focus` (and `--harmo-focus-outline` beside it), `--harmo-link-color-text`, `--harmo-link-visited-color-text`, and `--harmo-link-hover-text-decoration`. Focus and link colors don't follow `--harmo-color-primary`.
- For another accent color, prefer `data-harmo-accent` on `<html>` or a section over setting colors by hand: `purple` (default), `blue`, `teal`, `green`, `amber`, `red`, `pink`, or `mono` (black, or near-white in dark mode). Each passes WCAG AA in light and dark. `index.css` includes them, and `npx harmo-ui add` copies `accents.css` with `tokens.css`; otherwise load `accents.css` after `tokens.css`. An app's own token values on `:root` win over an accent on `<html>`; to change an accent on a section, override on that section.
- Dark mode: set `color-scheme: dark` on `:root`, or `light dark` to follow the system, or `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">`; without one, Harmo stays light. In a build that lowers `light-dark()` for older browsers, as Next.js 16's does by default, only the `color-scheme` in your compiled, unlayered CSS counts, and a section of its own (`.sidebar { color-scheme: dark }`) works only where the browser does `light-dark()` itself. Token colors are `light-dark()` pairs. A theme for both modes sets each color as a pair, and sets `--harmo-color-primary-fill`, `-fill-hover`, and `-fill-active` for what has white text on it (Button, Switch), since the dark primary is too light for that.

To copy components into a project instead of installing them, run `npx harmo-ui add <component>`. It copies each one to `components/harmo/<component>/`, or `src/components/harmo/<component>/` with a `src` folder, with its styles and what it needs; import `harmo.css` from that folder once. `npx harmo-ui list` lists the components. Copied components import from those files, not `@harmo-ui/react`; everything else below applies to them too.

Rules for using the React components (`@harmo-ui/react`):

- Import the CSS once (`@harmo-ui/css`), then the components. Each component page's React section lists its props; every other prop is the named element's native attribute, and `ref` reaches that element. A picker's `className` goes on its outer element, so a layout class sizes the whole control: Combobox's `.hcombobox`, Date Picker's `.hdate-picker`, Phone Input's `.hphone-input`, File Input's `.hfile-input`, and Select's and Time Picker's trigger; `ref` stays on the field or trigger.
- Harmo builds in no text. Pass every word a component shows or announces: Avatar's `alt` (`""` beside its name), Breadcrumb's `aria-label`, Table of Contents' `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, Language Picker's `aria-label` and each language's and region's `label`, Calendar's `locale`, `previousLabel` and `nextLabel`, Combobox's `removeLabel` and `moreLabel` with `multiple`, Command Menu's `label`, Composer's `aria-label` and `sendLabel` (and `stopLabel` with `onStop`, `attachLabel` with `onFiles`, `listLabel` with commands, and `editing`'s `title` and `cancelLabel`), Conversation's `aria-label` and `latestLabel`, Copy Button's and Share Button's `label` and `copiedLabel`, Copy Field's `copyLabel` and `copiedLabel`, Date Filter's `label` and `labels`, Dialog's and Drawer's `label` and `closeLabel`, Drop Zone's `label`, Empty State's `label` or `description`, Filters' `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` and `resetLabel` (and `moreLabel` with `visibleCount`), Filter Bar's `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, Selection Bar's `label` and `deselectLabel`, DataTable's `aria-label`, `selectAllLabel` and `selectRowLabel`, DataTableFooter's `summary`, `status` and `rowsPerPageLabel`, Date Picker's `calendarLabel`, Time Picker's `hourLabel`, `minuteLabel`, and `periodLabel`, Launcher's `aria-label` (and `buttonLabel` to say how many are new), Mentions' `listLabel` (or each `MentionsTrigger`'s), Menu Button's `aria-label`, Message's `failed` `message` and `retryLabel`, and `suggestionsLabel` with `suggestions`, Meter's `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, Navigation Menu's `aria-label`, Pagination's `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, `previousLabel` and `nextLabel` (and `pageLabel` with `numbered`), Sidebar's `aria-label` (and `collapseLabel` and `expandLabel` for its toggle), Spinner's label as children, Phone Input's `countryLabel`, `searchLabel`, and `emptyMessage`, Password Input's `showPasswordLabel` and `hidePasswordLabel` (and `strengthLabel` with `strength`), File Input's `chooseLabel` and `removeLabel` (and `dropLabel` on a strip or area), File List's `aria-label` (and `removeLabel` with `onRemove`, `retryLabel` with `onRetry`), Filter Chip's `label` (and `clearLabel` and `formatCount` with `multiple`, `emptyMessage` with `searchLabel`), Tag List's `moreLabel`, TabNav's and TabList's `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, TagRemove's `aria-label`, and Toaster's `aria-label`. TypeScript requires each where it's needed. Where Harmo writes a number or puts your words around a value, an optional function writes it your way instead: `formatCount` on Tag List, Combobox with `multiple`, Filters, and TextArea, and Date Filter's `labels.afterDate` and `labels.beforeDate`.
- Wrap a form control in `<Field label=…>` for its label, description, Optional marker, and error; Field connects their ids. Pass `error` to every field you validate, even while it's `undefined`, so the error can animate in. Checkbox, Radio, and Switch use `<Field orientation="horizontal">`. Select, Combobox, Date Picker, Time Picker, Phone Input, File Input, Segmented Control, RadioGroup, and CheckboxGroup take `label`, `optional`, `description`, and `error` themselves and render their Field. A control of your own, such as a rich-text editor, gets the Field's id, `aria-describedby`, and `aria-invalid` from `useField`.
- Choices are children: `<Select>`, `<Listbox>`, `<FilterChip>`, `<Combobox>`, and `<CommandMenu>` take `<Option value=…>` and `<OptionGroup label=…>`. Selection is `value` or `defaultValue` with `onValueChange`: a string, or an array with `multiple`; a Combobox that picks one, without free text, takes `null` for none, and a single-select Filter Chip given `clearLabel` gets `null` when it's cleared. A Command Menu keeps no selection: `onPick` gets the option's value. An `<Option>`'s `onClick` and a `<Listbox>`'s `onKeyDown` run before Harmo's handling: `preventDefault()` in them stops the choice or the key, and a disabled `<Option>` doesn't call `onClick`.
- Set the app's router link and image components once with `<HarmoProvider linkComponent={…} imageComponent={…}>`. Every link a component renders uses the link component (Link, Button and Card with `href`, ShowcaseCard, TabLink, FilterBarItem with `href`, NavigationMenuLink and NavigationMenuRow, Pagination with `href`, SidebarItem and SidebarSubItem, and DataTable's `rowHref`), and Avatar uses the image component. In the Next.js App Router, do it in a `"use client"` component that wraps the root layout's `children`: passing them directly from a Server Component fails the build.

## Docs

- [Components overview](docs/components/README.md): conventions, which files to load together, and what scripts handle
- [Accordion](docs/components/accordion.md): items that each show or hide their content, such as questions and their answers, one open at a time or several, with no script
- [Account Menu](docs/components/account-menu.md): who's signed in, their avatar, name, and a line such as their account, as a button that opens a Dropdown Menu of what's theirs, such as settings, accounts to switch to, and signing out; `profile` starts the menu with who's signed in, and many accounts go in a submenu; at the top of a Sidebar, collapsed, the avatar alone
- [Avatar](docs/components/avatar.md): a round user image, or a placeholder when there is none
- [Badge](docs/components/badge.md): a count that asks to be looked at, such as unread messages, red, the accent, or gray, or a dot; on a Button's corner with `badge`, hidden from screen readers, so the button's name says the count; one added after the page has loaded settles in
- [Banner](docs/components/banner.md): an inline notice: an icon, a message, and an optional action
- [Breadcrumb](docs/components/breadcrumb.md): a navigation trail ending at the current page
- [Button](docs/components/button.md): an action, as a button or as a link styled like one, or held to confirm one that's hard to undo; small, 29px, or extra small, 24px, which still takes presses over 34px; round with `shape="circle"`
- [Calendar](docs/components/calendar.md): a month of days to pick a date from, by pointer or keyboard, in the locale's language
- [Card](docs/components/card.md): a frame around a group of content: tinted, raised, or ghost for rows that lead somewhere; with a title, it lays out an icon, the title, a description, and a chevron, as in a list of settings pages
- [Showcase Card](docs/components/showcase-card.md): a card that shows where it leads before it's opened, with media on a dashed grid, a title, and an action line that comes up as it's hovered or focused, such as a product's news, or a gallery of templates or stories
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md): a native checkbox with Harmo's appearance
- [ChevronToArrow](docs/components/chevron-to-arrow.md): a chevron that turns into an arrow while its link or button is hovered or focused
- [Combobox](docs/components/combobox.md): a text field that filters a list as you type, to pick one or several from it or, with free text, be helped by it
- [Command Menu](docs/components/command-menu.md): places to go and things to do, found by typing: under a search field, or in a dialog
- [Composer](docs/components/composer.md): where a chat's message is written and sent: one box with the field, which grows, and Send, which turns into Stop while a reply comes; Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a line; attach or paste files, listed above the field; what the assistant knows about; editing a sent message in the field, with a bar quoting it; commands or mentions through Mentions; a note under it
- [Conversation](docs/components/conversation.md): the scrolling log a chat's Messages are in: it opens and stays at the latest unless you've scrolled up, then shows Jump to latest; a message of yours brings it back; a hidden status says what arrived; what shows before the first message; gathered at the foot like a messenger
- [Copy Button](docs/components/copy.md): copies text, such as a link or an ID, and says so in place, alone or in a field; a Share Button opens the device's share sheet, or copies the link
- [Date Filter](docs/components/date-filter.md): a chip that filters a list by date, with a value of `gte` and `lte` in Unix seconds that a URL can hold
- [Date Picker](docs/components/date-picker.md): a date typed in the locale's order, or chosen from a Calendar it opens
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md): a modal window for a task or a decision, opened by a button, code, or a link
- [Drawer](docs/components/drawer.md): a modal panel at the window's edge for a form or details, with an optional preview beside it
- [Drop Zone](docs/components/drop-zone.md): an area that takes files dropped anywhere on it, such as a chat or a list of attachments, with a dashed frame over it while files are dragged there; an extra for a pointer, paired with a File Input
- [Dropdown Menu](docs/components/dropdown-menu.md): a list of actions and links that a button opens, such as a row's More or a header's Create, in a Popup: items that are links or buttons, with an optional icon, `destructive` for one that destroys something, groups with labels, separators, and submenus (`DropdownMenuSub`), opened on hover or with →; the arrow keys, Home, End, and typing move focus through them, and choosing one closes it
- [Empty State](docs/components/empty-state.md): what shows where there's nothing yet: a list before its first item, a search with no results, or a page you can't see
- [Expand Chevron](docs/components/expand-chevron.md): a chevron that folds from down to up while its control is expanded
- [Field](docs/components/field.md): arranges and connects a label, description, control, and error message
- [File Input](docs/components/file-input.md): picks one file for your app to upload, shows its name, and removes it
- [File List](docs/components/file-list.md): the files your app is holding or sending: rows or a thumbnail grid, with progress and a way to try again
- [Filter Bar](docs/components/filter-bar.md): quick filters above a list, as a row of cards that each show how many items they'd leave
- [Filter Chip](docs/components/filter-chip.md): narrows a list or table: a dashed chip that opens a Popup and shows what's chosen
- [Filters](docs/components/filters.md): a row of filter chips above a list, with the rest behind a chip and a way to reset them all
- [Footer](docs/components/footer.md): the foot of a site's or an app's pages: a brand, groups of links, each a <details> that's open side by side and folds, as an Accordion item does, 640px wide or less, and a bottom row for the copyright and the small print
- [Header](docs/components/header.md): the bar across the top of a page or an app, a logo, navigation or search, and actions in a row; it stays at the top, frosted, with a hairline once the page has scrolled, or scrolls away (`data-scroll="away"`), or hides as you scroll down and comes back as you scroll up (`data-scroll="hide"`); `data-transparent` keeps it clear over a hero until the page scrolls
- [Icons](docs/components/icons.md): SVG icons placed next to text in buttons, links, and breadcrumbs
- [Input](docs/components/input.md): single-line native inputs: text, email, search, tel, url, and similar
- [Kbd](docs/components/kbd.md): a key or shortcut, such as Enter or ⌘K, in text or on a button
- [Language Picker](docs/components/language-picker.md): switches the language a site or app is in, with each language named in its own
- [Launcher](docs/components/launcher.md): a round button in the page's corner that opens a panel above it, a dialog that isn't modal, such as a support chat; it grows from the corner, the icon turns into a close icon, focus moves in and back, Escape closes it, a Badge counts what came while it was closed, and on a phone it takes the whole screen
- [Link](docs/components/link.md): navigation, inside text or on its own
- [Listbox](docs/components/listbox.md): the option list inside a popup, with groups, search, and multiple selection
- [Mentions](docs/components/mentions.md): a TextArea, or an Input with `singleLine`, that lists suggestions as a trigger is typed, such as @ for people, # for tags, or / at the start for a chat's commands, in a Popup with a Listbox, focus staying in the field; choosing one puts the trigger, its value, and a space in the text; a list for each trigger with `MentionsTrigger`, each mention highlighted as it's typed, and `mentionsIn` to find them
- [Menu Button](docs/components/menu-button.md): three bars that turn into a cross, for opening a site's menu on a phone
- [Message](docs/components/message.md): one message in a conversation: yours at the end in a bubble, the assistant's at the start, plain or in a bubble beside an avatar, or a system line; with its time, actions, quick replies, files, "Not sent" and a way to try again, or typing dots; a reply settles in as it arrives
- [Meter](docs/components/meter.md): how much of something on a fixed scale, such as password strength
- [Navigation Menu](docs/components/navigation-menu.md): a site's main navigation: links, and triggers that open a panel that resizes as you move between them, or stacked on a phone
- [OTP Input](docs/components/otp-input.md): a one-time code, such as a sign-in's second step, with a slot for each character over one field, which works without a script
- [Pagination](docs/components/pagination.md): moves through a list shown a page at a time: Previous and Next, and the page numbers if you show them
- [Password Input](docs/components/password.md): a password field with a show/hide toggle and an optional strength meter
- [Phone Input](docs/components/phone-input.md): a phone number, with a searchable country code, formatted as it's typed
- [Popup](docs/components/popup.md): a floating surface for option lists and small panels, aligned to its trigger's start, or its end with `align="end"`, below it, or above with `side="top"`
- [Prose](docs/components/prose.md): formatted text, such as an assistant's reply or a note, at the size of the text around it: paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, code, and links; in React, `text` formats a small part of Markdown as elements, never HTML, and `prosePlainText` gives it without its marks
- [Radio](docs/components/radio.md): a native radio with Harmo's appearance
- [Search](docs/components/search.md): a field for searching, such as above a list, with an optional clear button and shortcut hint
- [Section](docs/components/section.md): a part of a page, such as a group of settings: its title, a description, and actions, over its content
- [Segmented Control](docs/components/segmented.md): one choice from a few options shown side by side
- [Select](docs/components/select.md): a form field that picks one or more options from a list
- [Selection Bar](docs/components/selection-bar.md): what's selected in a list and what can be done with it: a count, a way to deselect, then the actions
- [Settings List](docs/components/settings.md): settings with a title, a description, and a control beside or under them
- [Sidebar](docs/components/sidebar.md): an app's navigation down the side: groups of links with icons, collapsing to the icons alone, each named in a tooltip
- [Spinner](docs/components/spinner.md): a loading indicator, sized to match what is loading
- [Stat](docs/components/stat.md): a number to watch, such as tickets today: its label, how it has changed, the number, and a caption, alone or as tiles on a tray
- [Status](docs/components/status.md): what state something is in, such as a ticket or a campaign run
- [Switch](docs/components/switch.md): an on/off switch for settings that apply immediately
- [Table](docs/components/table.md): rows and columns of data, as `.htable` on a normal table, or `<DataTable>` with selecting, row links, choosing columns, and a footer of pages
- [Table of Contents](docs/components/table-of-contents.md): the headings of a long page, beside it, with the one you've reached marked
- [Tabs](docs/components/tabs.md): switches between sibling pages or panels, with a sliding hover pill and underline
- [Tag](docs/components/tag.md): what something is, such as a ticket tag or "Test run", with an optional remove button
- [Tag List](docs/components/tag-list.md): tags in one row that never wraps, those that fit, then "+N" for the rest, shown on hover and focus
- [TextArea](docs/components/textarea.md): multi-line text that grows as you type
- [Time Picker](docs/components/time-picker.md): a time of day, chosen from columns of hours and minutes, on the locale's clock
- [Toast](docs/components/toast.md): a short message at the edge of the window that goes away by itself, with an optional action
- [Toolbar](docs/components/toolbar.md): a row above a list, with filters at the start and controls at the end
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md): a short description shown on hover and keyboard focus

## Patterns

Arrangements of components for a whole task, copied into an app with `npx harmo-ui add <pattern>` and changed there. In React, each form takes `action`, a React form action such as a Next.js server action, and answers with nothing, a message, messages by field, or a step; with a server action, it works without JavaScript, and messages can carry `values`, what was typed but never a password, to fill in again on the page a post renders. `titleAs` sets each form's heading level. Each pattern's page lists what to type in its demo, and everything your app and server need.

- [Sign-in Form](docs/patterns/sign-in-form.md): signs someone in with their email and password, or with another account such as Google, with a link to reset the password and, if you like, a code as a second step
- [Sign-up Form](docs/patterns/sign-up-form.md): creates an account with a name, an email, and a password, or with another account such as Google, with a link to sign in instead and, if you like, a step that confirms the email by a link or a code
- [Reset Password](docs/patterns/reset-password.md): sends a link to reset a forgotten password, then sets a new one
- [Account Forms](docs/patterns/account-forms.md): signs someone in, creates an account, or sends a link to reset a password, in one place, switching between the three forms without leaving the page, such as in a Dialog
- [Verify Code](docs/patterns/verify-code.md): asks for a one-time code, such as a sign-in's second step or one that confirms an email, sending itself once the code is whole, with a new code after a countdown
- [Chat](docs/patterns/chat.md): a conversation with an assistant, built from Conversation, Message, Prose, Composer, Mentions, Drop Zone, Launcher, and Badge, as an AI chat that fills the page beside a Sidebar of past chats, a copilot beside your app's content, or a support chat in a Launcher's panel over the page's corner that hands over to a person; `respond` returns each reply, whole or streamed, and replies show paragraphs, lists, code, bold, and links; `/` commands, files attached, dropped, or pasted, Stop, Try again, ratings, editing your last message, and a support chat's pushed messages, times, and unread count are built in
- [Footers](docs/patterns/footers.md): the foot of a page, built from Footer, Language Picker, Field, Input, and Button: a site's, with groups of links that fold on a phone, a Social group with icons, the copyright and the address; one with a newsletter sign-up beside its links; or a sign-in page's, the copyright and a few small links
- [Globe](docs/patterns/globe.md): the world in dots on a canvas, drawn with three.js, which the CLI installs: the land from Natural Earth twinkling and fading toward the edge, routes arcing between places with a light travelling each, turning slowly and with a drag; Pause and turn-left and turn-right Buttons in its corner (controls, on by default), dragging separately (dragRotate, on by default), paused at first with reduced motion, or by the page through paused; named with aria-label the picture is an image, otherwise decoration
- [Kanban](docs/patterns/kanban.md): a board of columns, built from Card, Badge, Status, Empty State, Button, Dropdown Menu, and Banner, with dnd kit, which the CLI installs: cards dragged with a mouse, a long press, or the keys, within a column or to another, or moved from each card's menu, and cards that link to their page or open in place, such as a Drawer of their status, assignee, and priority; your app saves each move, turns it down, which puts the card back with a Banner saying why, or asks first; and says where a card can't go
- [Headers](docs/patterns/headers.md): the bar across the top, built from Header, Navigation Menu, Menu Button, Command Menu, Popup, Badge, and Avatar: a site's, its menu sections opening panels, its menu and actions sliding in under the bar behind a Menu Button at 640px; an app's, beside its sidebar, a Command Menu at the start, its list opening under it, then Help, notifications with an unread count and Mark all as read, Settings, and a round Create with a short list of what to make; or a sign-in page's, the logo and one action
- [Contact Form](docs/patterns/contact-form.md): lets people reach your team, with forms for a message, a sales inquiry, a support request, and help with an order, and cards that lead to sales, support, and the help center; with `upload`, files go straight to your storage as they're added, and the form sends their keys
